dataset.description: Original Figshare26031226 version1 DOI10.6084/m9.figshare.26031226.v1, paired with author publication commit e3796c13fe7afe7a84854cd5a02c36de268e88f4. Deposit identity is known; authentic original trial/unit arrays and figure run linkage remain unqualified.

cohort.description: All five primary mice, one original session each: M22027_20220517, M22029_20220607, M22031_20220524, M22032_20220621, M22033_20220706. Preserve both states and every qualifying speed class. No Allen extension, dropped mouse, smaller population or selected time subset. Mice are independent; trials, neurons, windows and repeats are not.

split.description: Within-time: source random stratified threefold CV repeated five times, diagonal-covariance GammaOne route and inner fivefold delta tuning. Cross-time: source half train/half test repeated five times, nonoverlapping100ms windows and inner fivefold gamma/delta tuning. Exact source run/membership equivalence remains unbound. Authenticated original fixed partitions stay fixed; source stochastic draws may be faithfully replayed with recorded state and calibrated equivalence, paired between candidate and author. Chronological pooled-state splitting changes the task.

inputs.description: Source binned V1 spike counts and six visual-speed training labels, original trial and unit support, with separate stationary/locomotion dispatch. Test labels are operator-scored; no behavior/pupil shortcuts, source-private reference arrays, or pooled-state replacement. Neutral source-faithful preprocessing is common to both assistance arms; author fitting code is additional only in the code arm.

preprocessing.description: Retain source normal state criteria, full-contrast573-dot trials, duration tolerance, minimum trial balancing and unit filters isi_viol<=0.1, amplitude_cutoff<=0.1, amplitude>=50, dm_fr>=1. Within-time100ms windows advance10ms; cross-time100ms windows are nonoverlapping. Source inclusion masks and full-population invocation need authentication.

metric.description: Held-test accuracy is correct/test trials, chance1/6. Within-time folds are averaged equally, not pooled by fold size. Retain raw cross-time accuracy and equation21 ratio of positive above-chance sums after repeat averaging, including its diagonal denominator. A higher relative ratio due to a degraded denominator is not improvement.

aggregation.description: Retain all five repeats and all mouse/state/time/class support:191 within-time windows and20x20 cross-time matrices. Average folds equally, then repeats within mouse; source cohort mean and sample SEM weight five mice equally. Relative generalization is computed per mouse after repeat averaging, with test windows0–1000ms and early100–200ms train profile; preserve all20 diagnostic row reductions, published first12 train-window profile support, numerator/diagonal denominator and undefined states. No fabricated grand-mean accuracy baseline.

comparison.primary_metric: Full original state-specific six-speed within-time and cross-time held-test accuracy panel, with protected source relative-generalization companions; true-label accuracy targets only, null/ratio companions protected

published_baseline.description: Complete original Figure2h/4d accuracy vectors/matrices and mouse support are unrecovered. Figure4e stationary0.25±0.04 and locomotion0.58±0.07 are preserved relative-generalization companions, not accuracy baselines or an invented combined scalar.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Strongest relevant original author routes on the same admitted data: within-time independent-neuron diagonal-covariance GammaOne LDA with source nested delta tuning; cross-time source LDA with source gamma/delta tuning and half splits. Full source native performance vectors remain unrecovered. Frozen-coefficient transport, pooled chronological LDA, chance1/6 and Figure4e relative scalars are not substitutes.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful native-unit gain and complete-panel rule require the authenticated author distribution and qualified stochastic replay. No new scalar, significance objective, zero-margin shortcut or numerical placeholder is authorized.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired mouse-level complete-panel uncertainty and multiplicity on original support; source folds, sessions and shuffles are not independent biological replicates.
uncertainty.rationale: Windows, trials and CV repeats must not inflate biological replication; no ungrounded alpha or minimum delta is imposed.

paper_win_requires: Strongest relevant original author routes on the same admitted data: within-time independent-neuron diagonal-covariance GammaOne LDA with source nested delta tuning; cross-time source LDA with source gamma/delta tuning and half splits. Full source native performance vectors remain unrecovered. Frozen-coefficient transport, pooled chronological LDA, chance1/6 and Figure4e relative scalars are not substitutes.

Relative-generalization ratios, their numerator/denominator, source biological contrasts and any shuffle/null outputs are fidelity/protection companions, never targets rewarded merely for increasing. Ratios cannot improve by degrading their diagonal denominator.
